Retribution Paladin DPS Gear and Best in Slot — 12.1

OverallMythic+Raid

This list contains the BiS items from any source for Midnight Season 2. Although this is a theoretical best list, the best item for your character specifically can often be different depending on other items currently equipped.

This list is intended as a reference, but we always recommend confirming by simming yourself. Depending on the exact gear you have available, your best gear to use might look different than this list for some slots.

FAQWhich Tier Set Pieces Do I Want?
Catalyzing items in Midnight Season 2 works differently, as items keep their previous stats and effects. This means that the original item's source matters a lot. These are strong items to catalyze in each slot:
  • Helm - Skullguard of the Risen Sacrifice from Nek'zali
  • Shoulders - Cinderfury Shoulderguards from Murder Row
  • Chest - Reckless Spirit Breastplate from Coiled Altar
  • Hands - Bonds of the Hash'ura from Den of Nalorakk
  • Legs - Chausses of Unbound Rancor from Ula'tek
FAQWhat to Take From The Great Vault?

The most important item to take is a Myth track weapon. After acquiring that, or if you don't hit one, trinkets or 6/6 Myth items are good choices, but otherwise you may want to take bonus rolls instead.

Instead of picking an item from the Great Vault, you can instead choose to take a Nebulous Voidcore. This lets you bonus roll on any dungeon or boss, and receive a 1/6 Myth track version of the item for Heroic raid and Mythic +10 dungeons, or 6/6 Myth for Mythic raid. Details on bonus rolling strategies can be found below.

TipsWhich Dungeons Should I Farm?
If you have limited time to play the game, we recommend to farm the following dungeons:
  • Ruby Life Pools, Blinding Vale, Altar of Fangs: All drop weapons and useful trinkets.
  • Weapon: Any of Ruby Life Pools, Murder Row, and Altar of Fangs drop a weapon with good stats.
  • Trinkets: Altar of Fangs, Blinding Vale, and Ruby Life Pools have the best trinket options from dungeons.

TipsWhich Raid-Items Do I Want Most?
If you need to submit a list of highly-important items to your raidleader, or simply want to focus on the most important bosses and items these are the best available:
  • Maze-roa, Warlord's Fury: Our BiS weapon. Drops from Coiled Altar.
  • Voracious Heart of Ula'tek: The best on-use trinket. Drops from Ula'tek.
  • Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique: The best passive trinket. Also from Coiled Altar.
